# em portageq has_version

Exit 0 if ATOM is installed under EROOT, 1 otherwise

## Usage

```
em portageq has_version [OPTIONS] <EROOT> <ATOM>
```

## Arguments

* `<EROOT>`
* `<ATOM>`

## Options

* `-h, --help` — Print help (see a summary with '-h')

## Global options

* `--color <WHEN>` — \[default: auto\]
  * `auto`: Colour when stdout is a terminal.
  * `always`: Always colour.
  * `never`: Never colour.
